_note: Cirrus SR22T G5 -- every number below is read from the Pilot's Operating Handbook P/N 13772-005 (3600 lb unless stated). See _sources. Items under _model are modelling assumptions, NOT POH data.
name: Cirrus SR22T (G5 POH)

_sources.vr: Sec 4 Airspeeds for Normal Operation: Takeoff rotation, normal, flaps 50% = 80 KIAS
_sources.vy_roc: Sec 5 Takeoff Climb Gradient, flaps 50%, 3600 lb, SL, ISA: 91 KIAS, 782 ft/NM -> 782*91/60 = 1186 fpm
_sources.ground_roll: Sec 5 Takeoff Distance 3600 lb, flaps 50%, SL ISA ground roll 1517 ft (2900 lb: 544 ft -> weight exponent ln(1517/544)/ln(3600/2900)=4.7; 4000 ft ISA: 1856 ft -> density exponent 0.98)
_sources.glide: Sec 3 Maximum Glide: best glide 92 KIAS at 3600 lb, max glide ratio ~8.6:1, prop windmilling, flaps up
_sources.stall: Sec 5 Stall Speeds 3600 lb, 0 deg bank, most fwd CG, KIAS: flaps 0% 74, flaps 50% 70, flaps 100% 64
_sources.landing: Sec 5 Landing Distance 3600 lb, flaps 100%, SL ISA ground roll 1178 ft; speed over 50 ft 79 KIAS (VREF used as touchdown speed)
_sources.caps_speed: Sec 3 CAPS Deployment: max demonstrated deployment speed 140 KIAS
_sources.caps_loss: Sec 10 Deployment Altitude: no minimum altitude set; level-flight altitude loss demonstrated < 400 ft; POH advises >= 2000 ft AGL if circumstances permit
_sources.caps_min_agl_level_ft: NOT a POH value: owner-specified planning minimum (600 ft AGL)

_model: flap_cd0_delta, landing roll_margin_factor, CAPS inflation_time_s / forward_travel_ft / decision_time, and all 'pilot' entries are modelling assumptions.
